description: This file defines the class 'IntentBuilderView', a custom Android UI component that allows users to build and configure Intents with various flags and target activities. It provides user interface elements like checkboxes and radio buttons to select flags and target activities, and manages interactions such as launching activities with the constructed intent.

classes.name: IntentBuilderView
classes.description: A custom Android FrameLayout that provides a user interface for constructing and launching intents with various configurations, including flags and target activities.

methods.name: IntentBuilderView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view with a specified context and mode.

methods.name: currentIntent
methods.description: Constructs and returns the current Intent based on user-selected flags and activity.

methods.name: startForResult
methods.description: Determines whether the intent should be started for a result based on UI state.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on activity radio buttons to set the target activity.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in checkbox and switch states to update suggestions and verification mode.

methods.name: clearFlags
methods.description: Resets all flag checkboxes to unchecked state.

methods.name: selectFlags
methods.description: Selects checkboxes corresponding to a list of flag names.

methods.name: selectFlags
methods.description: Selects checkboxes corresponding to a collection of IntentFlag objects.

methods.name: getAllCheckBoxes
methods.description: Returns a list of all CheckBox views within the flag builder layout.

methods.name: childrenOfGroup
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve children of a given ViewGroup that match a specific class type.

methods.name: getCheckedFlags
methods.description: Returns a collection of IntentFlag objects for all checked checkboxes.

methods.name: disableFlags
methods.description: Disables checkboxes associated with the given flags.

methods.name: getCheckBox
methods.description: Finds the checkbox corresponding to a specific IntentFlag.
